title: Bleach Reveals New Look at Major Event for the Anime’s Grand Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has officially brought the end to the long running anime after 22 years, and a new look has been revealed at a huge event coming next year to help say goodbye to the franchise after all this time.
author: ComicBook

title: New Hana-Kimi Live-Action Series Reveals Theme Songs, Short Video
content: The staff for the new live-action television series based on the late Hisaya Nakajo 's classic shōjo manga Hana-Kimi ( Hana Zakari no Kimi-tachi e ) revealed on Friday the show's theme song artists as well as a 15-second video.
author: ANN

title: Boruto Just Revealed an Epic New Duo Rivaling Naruto and Sasuke
content: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 39 confirms the franchise’s new duo, and they might be more compatible than Naruto and Sasuke. Although Naruto and Sasuke are equally strong and have been teammates for a long time, their compatibility has always been one of their biggest issues.
author: ComicBook

title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Webtoon Returns With Season 2 on November 24
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account of Korean webtoon and web novel production company REDICE STUDIO announced on November 20 the Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint webtoon will return for its second season on November 24 at 10:00 p.m. KST (8:00 a.m. EST).
author: ANN

title: Tamon's B-Side Anime Gets 2nd Season
content: Viz Media licensed the manga, and it describes the story: High schooler UtaGe! Kinoshita works part-time as a housekeeper so she can afford her fangirl obsession with Tamon Fukuhara, her favorite member of boy band F/ACE.
author: ANN

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, November 9-15
content: The television ratings above are an estimate of the percentage of the population that watch a given program, based on data from a survey of households in Japan's Kanto region. The ratings do not count recordings that viewers watch later.
author: ANN

title: Doraemon Anime's 1-Hour New Year's Special to Feature New Tool
content: The official website for the Doraemon franchise announced on Friday the anime will again get a one-hour New Year's Eve special, which this year will air on December 31 at 8:00 a.m. JST. The new special will focus on adapting for the first time the "secret tool memo" by Fujiko F.
author: ANN

title: Tamon's B-Side Gets Season 2
content: Tamon’s B-Side anime is getting a Season 2. An announcement trailer was also revealed but the release date is yet to be announced. J.C. Staff is animated the first season with Chika Nagaoka as director. Chiaki Nagai was in charge of writing the series composition and scripts.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!?' Second Season in Production
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yuki Shiwasu 's Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!? ( Tamon's B-Side ) manga announced a second season on Saturday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured). Produced by J.C.Staff , the anime aired for 13 episodes in Winter 2026.
author: MyAnimeList
